svg.aria-label: Platform at a glance — the monorepo publishes versioned packages, game repos install them, a merge to main ships through acidstates/workflows onto the droplet, game manifests feed the catalog and the stands
svg.title: Platform at a glance · ACID//STATES
svg.text: ACIDSTATES · PACKAGE → MODULE → OWN REPO → MERGE TO MAIN → LIVE

g.text: PACKAGES → GAMES · ONE MODULE PER GAME
RGS backend + PixiJS client · sealed payout path (compliance_files)
math versions per game · game-manifest.json declares the deploy target
game.config.json · sound passport · math passport — facts as data,
never read from a game's sources by a stand
read the catalog, not the code
rollback is a fallback, never the first response

svg.text: platform: merge to main ships the stands
SemVer tags version packages; main ships services — every accepted deploy is marked with a deploy/<target> tag afterwards
the seal: a test fails the build the moment a money-moving file drifts out of compliance_files; the lab gets compliance_version
